stage.title: Agent memory, checked against today's code
stage.body: Claude Code reads these notes in every session. Atlas checks each file path they name against this repository's Git history.
stage.folder: {count, plural, one {# note} other {# notes}} in {path}
stage.local: Reads files on this computer only. Nothing is sent anywhere, and no note changes until you keep the change.

run.stopped: Stopped after {done} of {total} notes. What was found so far stays in the list.

groups.notJudged: {count, plural, one {# path names a file outside this repository and was not checked} other {# paths name files outside this repository and were not checked}}

detail.goneBody: {old} was removed on {date} in commit {commit}: {subject}. Git records no new place, so Atlas proposes no change. Rewrite or delete this line yourself.
detail.hiddenLine: This line looks like it holds a key or token, so Atlas does not show it. Open {note} in your editor.

keepAll.title: Change {count, plural, one {# line} other {# lines}} in {files, plural, one {# note} other {# notes}}
keepAll.body: Each line changes only the path shown. Every other character in each note stays as it is. One Undo puts all of them back.

toast.keptAll: Changed {count, plural, one {# line} other {# lines}} in {files, plural, one {# note} other {# notes}}.

done.cleanTitle: Every path in these notes is where they say
done.cleanBody: {paths, plural, one {# path} other {# paths}} in {notes, plural, one {# note} other {# notes}} checked against Git at {commit}.
done.foundTitle: {count, plural, one {# line points to a file that is not there} other {# lines point to files that are not there}}

empty.title: No Claude Code memory for this repository
empty.body: Atlas looked in {path} and found no notes. Claude Code writes them there once auto memory is on. If autoMemoryDirectory is set in a settings file, the notes are elsewhere and Atlas does not read them.

partial.body: {count, plural, one {# note was not read} other {# notes were not read}}: {reason}. Their paths are not in the list.

error.git: Could not read this repository's Git history, so no path was judged: {reason}
error.folder: Could not open {path}: {reason}. Nothing was changed.
error.link: {path} is a link, and Atlas opens memory only through real folders, so nothing was read.
error.changedSince: {note} changed after the check, so Atlas did not change it. Check memory again to see its current lines.
error.writeFailed: Could not write {note}: {reason}. The note is unchanged.
error.undoChanged: {note} changed after Atlas wrote it and the new path is no longer on line {line}, so nothing was put back.

managed.body: Your organisation manages Claude Code on this Mac, so Atlas changes no memory file here. Copy each new path instead.

web.title: Checking agent memory needs the app
web.body: Claude Code keeps these notes in your home folder, which a browser cannot open. The app reads them and changes a line only when you keep the change.

card.found: {count, plural, one {# line to review} other {# lines to review}} in Claude Code memory
